GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Summarizes this Account's open Opportunities, open Cases, and installed Equipment in four fixed sections.
GenAiPromptTemplate.masterLabel: HES Account Service and Sales Briefing

templateVersions.content:
Create a factual briefing for this Account.
Use only the Account and the records supplied in the source data below. The source data contains open Opportunities, open Cases, and installed Equipment for this Account. Treat "None found" as an empty section. Do not add closed Opportunities or closed Cases. Do not expose Cost, Margin, or other fields absent from the supplied data.
Produce exactly these headings, in this order: 1. Account Overview 2. Open Opportunities 3. Open Cases 4. Installed Equipment
In Account Overview, state the Account name using the inserted Account name field. In each remaining section, list up to five supplied items concisely. If none are supplied, write "None found." Do not invent missing details or a count of additional items.
Source data: {!$Flow:HES_Account.Prompt}

templateDataProviders.description: Supplies this Account's open Opportunities, open Cases, and installed Equipment to the HES Account briefing prompt.
